title: Yaare Neenu Cheluve
desc: A woman loses her bag which contains important documents and a man ends up finding it. Later, he sends it to her along with a letter which begins a romantic exchange amongst them.

title: Inspector Vijay
desc: Vijay, an honest police officer, meets Samyukta at a cafe and falls in love with her. However, his life changes when he witnesses a kidnapping and ends up helping a lonely woman, Lavanya.

title: Johnny Johnny Yes Papa
desc: Johnny, along with his father, works for social causes under the pretext of a software management firm. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he meets Priya and falls for her.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reform act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda 2
desc: A devoted dog does not move from his owner's grave, maintaining a constant watch. Years later, a young boy develops a unique bond with the loyal dog, resulting in an incredible companionship.

title: Luna
desc: A team of six people must employ an army of robots in order to fight and defeat the aliens invading and destroying the planet.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Navathare
desc: Partha wants to play cricket but his father strives to stop him at every step. Eventually, when he is thrown out of the cricket academy due to his father's influence, he starts using drugs.

title: Preethse
desc: Surya, a military commander, is soon to be engaged to Kiran, a college student. Unbeknownst to him, one of Kiran's classmates is also in love with her.
